He orchestrated the escalating cruelty and a magical charm that inflamed Rose and Dimitri's passion, all as part of a plan to exploit Lissa's rare spirit magic, which can heal, to cure his own deadly disease. Victor abducts Lissa and drains her by forcing her to heal him repeatedly. Rose, guided by the bond and aided by Dimitri and the guardians, tracks them down and rescues Lissa. in_short: Rose Hathaway, a dhampir training to guard the mortal Moroi vampires, and her best friend Lissa Dragomir, the last of a royal line, are captured after two years hiding among humans and returned to St. Vladimir's Academy. Rose is bound to Lissa by a rare psychic link and trains under the guardian Dimitri Belikov, with whom she shares a forbidden attraction. At school someone begins terrorizing Lissa with dead animals and threats, while Lissa manifests an unknown magic called spirit that lets her heal and influence others, at a growing cost to her mind. The menace turns out to be Victor Dashkov, a trusted family friend, who has engineered the harassment and even a charm to inflame Rose and Dimitri, all to force Lissa to heal his fatal illness with her spirit power. Victor kidnaps Lissa; Rose and Dimitri track them down and free her. Victor's daughter Natalie, who has willingly turned Strigoi to aid his escape, attacks Rose and is killed. Victor is captured, and it is revealed that Lissa long ago used spirit to bring Rose back from death, which created their bond and marked Rose as shadow-kissed.

recaps.text: Rose Hathaway, a seventeen-year-old dhampir training to guard the mortal Moroi vampires, and her royal Moroi best friend Lissa Dragomir have spent two years hiding among humans. They are hunted down and captured by guardians led by the disciplined Dimitri Belikov and returned to St. Vladimir's Academy, the vampire boarding school they fled. The world's order is laid out: living Moroi vampires wield elemental magic, half-human dhampirs like Rose serve as their protectors, and the undead Strigoi are the deadly enemy of both. Rose is bound to Lissa by a rare one-way psychic link that lets her feel Lissa's emotions and slip into her mind. The headmistress nearly expels Rose but relents, and Rose is allowed back only if she submits to extra combat training under Dimitri to catch up. Rose fears the reason they ran in the first place has not gone away, and that Lissa is still in danger.

Rose and Lissa fall back into the cruel social world of the academy, where the ambitious Mia works to humiliate them and Lissa's cousin Natalie offers easy friendship. Lissa is drawn to Christian Ozera, a brooding outcast shunned because his parents became Strigoi, and Rose worries the attachment will bring trouble. Rose's training with Dimitri intensifies, and the forbidden tension between them deepens. Then someone begins tormenting Lissa: a mutilated animal is left for her to find, and cruel messages follow, feeding a private fear Lissa carries about herself. Rose, watching through their bond, sees Lissa's fragile control slipping, and realizes that whatever drove them to flee has followed them back to school and is closing in again.

The threats against Lissa grow bolder and more frightening, and Rose struggles to protect her while hiding how much of Lissa's pain she shares through the bond. Lissa's unusual magic comes into focus: she can heal wounds and sway people's feelings, a power unlike the ordinary elements the Moroi command, but using it drains and destabilizes her, driving her toward despair and self-harm. Rose's own feelings for Dimitri surge with unexpected, dangerous intensity, and the two are barely able to keep their distance. As Rose digs for who is behind the persecution and why Lissa's gift makes her a target, the pressure on both girls mounts toward a crisis, and Rose senses that the danger is far closer to home than anyone suspects.

The campaign against Lissa is revealed to be the work of Victor Dashkov, the ailing prince the girls trusted as a family friend. He orchestrated the escalating cruelty, and even a magical charm that inflamed Rose and Dimitri's passion, as part of a plan to exploit Lissa's rare healing magic to cure his own fatal disease. Victor abducts Lissa and forces her to heal him. Guided by the bond and aided by Dimitri and the guardians, Rose tracks them down and frees her. During the confrontation Victor's meek daughter Natalie reveals she has willingly become a Strigoi, gaining monstrous strength to help her father escape, and she attacks Rose, who is forced to kill her. Victor is taken into custody to face justice. In the aftermath the source of Rose and Lissa's connection is explained: in the crash that killed the Dragomirs, Lissa unknowingly used her magic to bring the dying Rose back to life, binding them and marking Rose as shadow-kissed. The two remain at the academy, their friendship intact, and Rose accepts the pull she feels toward Dimitri even as duty stands between them.
